2 AM “Healthy” Buldak Dumpling Ramen 🍝😆 Ingredients 1 pack Buldak ramen 2 slices Baby Swiss cheese 1 slice American cheese 2 tbsp ketchup 1 tbsp mayonnaise 1 tbsp chili oil 1 Buldak sauce packet 1 Buldak seasoning packet 1 tbsp chopped green onions ¾–1 cup heavy cream 4–6 dumplings, cooked 6 cocktail sausages, cooked and scored Extra green onions, chili oil, and sesame seeds for garnish Instructions Cook the Buldak noodles for about half of the recommended cooking time, then drain and set aside. In a pan over low heat, add the Baby Swiss cheese, American cheese, ketchup, mayonnaise, chili oil, Buldak sauce packet, Buldak seasoning packet, and chopped green onions. Stir everything together until the cheese melts and the mixture is smooth. Pour in the heavy cream and mix until creamy and well combined. Add the partially cooked noodles and toss to coat. Let them finish cooking in the sauce for 2–3 minutes, stirring occasionally, until tender and creamy. Top with the cooked dumplings and scored sausages. Finish with extra green onions, and drizzle of chili oil. Serve immediately while hot and creamy. . #buldak #buldakramen #food #Foodie #cook
